title: I-820 photos
text: Reconstruction and expansion of the interchange at SH 121 and the shared section of freeway north of the interchange took place in the first half of the 2020s. By 2025 all work was complete. However, the work completed is the "interim" design for the interchange. In 2017 TxDOT provided a schematic of the ultimate design, which includes additional lanes, both general purpose and managed. As of 2026, there are no plans to proceed with the ultimate design.

images.caption: This view is on SH 121 (Airport Freeway) going westbound, with the exit to I-820 ahead.
On the connection ramp from SH 121 westbound to I-820 southbound.
The connection ramps are long and cross through a wooded area on the southwest side of the interchange.
After turning around, the following views are northbound along I-820. This is the entrance at Randol Mill Road.
The connection ramps at SH 121 are ahead.

This view shows the long connection ramps, which cross through a wooded area on the southwest side of the interchange. The ramp on the left has a stub-out for a future connection to Hurst Blvd westbound in the ultimate design for the interchange. However, as of 2026 there are no plans to complete the interchange to the ultimate design.
Traffic from SH 121 merges in ahead.
Taking the exit to the SH 121 toll express lanes.
Toll gantry for the toll express lanes.
